title: Great bottle, so-so cap.
text: Great bottle, so-so cap.. Just what I was looking for to make homemade salad dressings. I can tell the cap isn't going to last long, but that seems like a cheap piece to pick up in bulk elsewhere for the inevitable need to replace soon.
